name: ComfortZone Essential Task Chair C100
description: Meet the ComfortZone Essential Task Chair C100, the perfect seating solution for your home office, dorm room, or study area. This chair was designed with one goal in mind: to provide dependable comfort and core functionality at an unbeatable value. It features a breathable mesh back to help you stay cool, and a comfortably padded fabric seat for hours of work or study. The simple pneumatic lever allows for easy seat height adjustment to fit your desk, while the durable five-star base and smooth-rolling casters provide stable mobility. This chair is for students, casual home office users, and anyone needing a reliable chair without the complexity and cost of high-end ergonomic models. It's an excellent choice for completing homework, paying bills, or general computer use. While it lacks advanced adjustments like lumbar support or adjustable armrests, its straightforward design is easy to assemble and use right out of the box. The Essential Task Chair C100 delivers on its promise of being a simple, affordable, and comfortable seating solution for everyday tasks. For academic research purposes only. Features: Breathable mesh backrest, Padded fabric seat cushion, Pneumatic seat height adjustment, 360-degree swivel capability, Durable nylon base with dual-wheel casters. Advantages: Very affordable price point; Easy and quick to assemble; Breathable back is comfortable for short-to-medium sessions. Considerations: Lacks advanced ergonomic adjustments like lumbar or armrest controls; Not designed for all-day, continuous use. Best for: Students, budget-conscious consumers, and individuals who need a simple, functional task chair for short-term daily use.
